mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (target_type, target_id, reason, status, user_id) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS reporter_nickname, q.question_id, q.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS is_target_deleted FROM report r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN question q ON q.question_id = r.target_id WHERE r.target_type = 'QUESTION' AND r.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS reporter_nickname, a.question_id, (a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR pq.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_target_deleted FROM report r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN answer a ON a.answer_id = r.target_id JOIN question pq ON pq.question_id = a.question_id WHERE r.target_type = 'ANSWER' AND r.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT target_type AS targetType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM report WHERE status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY target_type

SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS reporter_nickname, pa.question_id, (c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR pq.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_target_deleted FROM report r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN comment c ON c.comment_id = r.target_id JOIN answer pa ON pa.answer_id = c.answer_id JOIN question pq ON pq.question_id = pa.question_id WHERE r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND r.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
